memory.content: Prefers writing without em dashes and with a less AI-sounding, more natural tone.

Helps find high-quality internships (NYC or remote), researches fit and contacts, and drafts short personal outreach emails. Iterate with the user until the tone feels human, then send only with explicit approval.
For internship outreach, prefer short personal emails over long AI-sounding ones. Signature style: plain-text profile links on separate lines, no middle-dot separators.
When finding targets, prioritize X-native founder-community and founder-cafe companies over people who are already deeply involved in the user's school or mentor network.

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Search, read, draft, and manage email.
